successor_assignment.semantics: WP1D intentionally left its next exact subpackage ID unassigned. This successor contract newly assigns WP1E to the component gauge-operator and projector-kernel preflight; it is not claimed to have been pre-specified by WP1D.

background_ansatz.metric: dsbar6^2 = exp(2A(r))*qbar_munu dx^mu dx^nu + dr^2 + L(r)^2 dchi^2
background_ansatz.fourD_covariant_derivative: D_mu is the covariant derivative of qbar_munu

gauge_parameter_convention.fourD_split: zeta_mu=zetaT_mu + D_mu zeta_L, with D^mu zetaT_mu=0, only on a declared projector representative slice
gauge_parameter_convention.raised_internal_components: zeta^r=zeta_r and zeta^chi=zeta_chi/L^2 on the punctured polar chart L>0; no bounded-coordinate-component claim is made at a smooth pole
gauge_parameter_convention.representative_firewall: zeta_L and all York/Hodge potentials are equivalence-class representatives modulo projector kernels; a kernel representative must not be counted as an additional gauge direction

raw_gauge_operator.definition: G_raw(zeta,lambda,rho) acts by Lie_zeta on background bulk fields, by d lambda in U1, and by independent intrinsic Lie_rho on interface pullback representatives
raw_gauge_operator.bulk_gauge: delta a_A = Lie_zeta Abar_A + partial_A lambda
raw_gauge_operator.interface_intrinsic: delta_rho t = Lie_rho Tbar for an interface perturbation t of background pullback Tbar, together with delta_rho tau^a=rho^a in the active representative convention

bulk_metric_component_action.delta_h_munu: 2 D_(mu zetaT_nu) + 2 D_mu D_nu zeta_L + 2 A_prime exp(2A) qbar_munu zeta_r

conditional_4D_coefficient_action.projector_warning: these coefficient transformations are not a global field-space theorem until the York/Hodge representative and its kernel complement are fixed

scalar_metric_and_scalar_field.hhat_chichi: h_chichi-2 partial_chi X_chi-2 L L_prime X_r

conditional_kinematic_invariants.division_firewall: no invariant above divides by phibar_prime, Abar_chi_prime, Fourier n, k, D2, or any background residual; inverse powers of L are polar-coordinate metric factors and are not licensed as bounded polewise component expressions without smooth-extension analysis

polar_coordinate_firewall.coordinate_issue: the polar chart degenerates at a smooth pole where L=0, so zeta^chi=zeta_chi/L^2 and terms with L_prime/L or Abar_chi_prime/L^2 must not be assessed by boundedness of individual polar components
polar_coordinate_firewall.primary_regularity_rule: admissibility at each pole is smooth Cartesian extendibility of the underlying vector, tensor, scalar and U1 one-form fields, as frozen by WP1D
polar_coordinate_firewall.important_counterexample: a smooth Cartesian translation vector has polar contravariant angular component proportional to 1/r near r=0, so a divergent angular coordinate component does not by itself signal a singular vector field
polar_coordinate_firewall.background_regular_gauge_note: the frozen regular pole gauge has A_chi=0 at the pole and the canonical pole series begins quadratically in the angular potential, but this block does not use that fact to claim regularity of every perturbative representative
polar_coordinate_firewall.component_formula_domain: punctured polar chart L>0 plus a separate smooth-extension requirement
polar_coordinate_firewall.required_later: rewrite/check the relevant internal components in smooth Cartesian or orthonormal-frame variables and verify mode-by-mode pole extension before any global mode or norm claim

interface_full_gauge_firewall.H_ab: bulk-diffeomorphism compensated but transforms under independent intrinsic rho as Lie_rho hbar_ab
interface_full_gauge_firewall.d_a: U1 invariant but transforms under intrinsic rho as the perturbation of an interface one-form
interface_full_gauge_firewall.consequence: raw interface components must not be advertised as invariants of the full G_cond quotient
interface_full_gauge_firewall.safe_object: surface tensor/one-form equivalence classes modulo intrinsic Lie_rho or a later explicitly frozen surface gauge

kernel_classes_to_track: scalar-potential representatives annihilated by D_mu or the relevant Hessian map
constant or zero modes when admitted by the declared domain
projector_kernel_audit.rule: kernel representatives are quotient/representation ambiguities, not automatically physical modes

regime_checks.phibar_prime_zero: varphihat reduces smoothly to varphi; no unitary-gauge division is used
regime_checks.Abar_chi_prime_zero: Ahat_r and Ahat_chi reduce smoothly to U1-invariant u_r and u_chi
regime_checks.A_prime_zero: metric formulas reduce smoothly to unwarped radial controls
regime_checks.L_prime_zero_away_from_pole: internal metric formulas reduce smoothly to cylindrical-radius stationary control where L remains nonzero
regime_checks.smooth_pole_L_zero: coordinate-component formulas containing 1/L or 1/L^2 are not evaluated by naive substitution; smooth Cartesian or orthonormal-frame extension is required
regime_checks.projector_kernel_nontrivial: coefficient-level invariants remain conditional and may not define field-space observables

forbidden_inferences: The current static ansatz is not an established physical background solution.
Representative-level York/Hodge coefficients are not global physical variables before projector kernels and domains are frozen.
Polar coordinate factors 1/L and 1/L^2 do not by themselves establish a singularity or regularity at L=0; only smooth tensorial extension can decide the pole limit.
The current representative-level hatted combinations have not yet been proven to extend componentwise through the smooth poles.
H_ab and d_a are not invariants of the full intrinsic-surface reparameterization quotient merely because they are invariant under one gauge channel.
Rank or kernel of the kinematic gauge operator is not a physical DOF count before ULSH04 closes the constraint algebra.
No formal or numerical inverse of D2 may be used to erase zero modes silently.
No physical kinetic matrix, ghost, gradient, tachyon, KK-spectrum or stability claim follows.
No 6D-to-4D observable map or HZT mu, eta, Sigma, growth or lensing prediction follows.
No backend import or solver execution is authorized.
